product_summary: White Ice Granite is a light-colored Brazilian natural stone countertop offering exceptional durability and heat resistance for kitchen applications. As a lighter granite variety, it requires more frequent sealing than darker stones but provides 100+ year lifespan with proper maintenance.

underperforms_expectations: No manufacturer warranty on the stone itself - only fabricator workmanship coverage
Warranty excludes staining, etching, and cracking from normal settling
surprises: Warranty is non-transferable and depends entirely on your local fabricator
Natural variation in the stone is specifically excluded from coverage

buyer_considerations.text: Requires resealing every 1-3 years or staining becomes permanent - lighter colors like White Ice need more frequent maintenance than darker granite
Brazilian granite is more porous than Indian varieties, meaning higher staining risk and maintenance demands despite proper sealing
Countertops installed 1980s-2000s with steel reinforcement develop straight-line cracks from rust expansion - check fabricator reinforcement method

serviceability_summary: No centralized service network - repair and maintenance quality depends entirely on your local stone fabricator
price_positioning: Priced mid-range for natural stone countertops
material_health_summary: EPA-verified safe for residential use with no meaningful radiation risk above normal background levels
